notes.title: 2.0 Update Now Live! - Featuring Co-Op, Unlockables, & More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce we've made live the 2.0 Update for KDD. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239510/0027a8c5da6806dc1a58720835b54e3980eea18c.png[/img]

Technically the soundtrack isn't live yet - it's coming soon and will be live on the 14th of April. But other than that, we've added a new trailer and updated the store page to reflect the new features.

New features include:
[list]
[*]Local Competitive Multiplayer (Compatible with Steam Remote Play!)
[*]New Unlockables - Character Galleries, Radio Stations, and more!
[*]New Characters + Outfits, all with unique skills
[*]New Areas!
[/list]

We hope you all enjoy the update!

notes.title: Overhaul Update - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been awhile since our last update, and we apologize! We've been hard at work behind the scenes, and are happy to say that we are almost ready for the release of our Overhaul Update. This update features a ton of new features, including in-game achievements and unlockables (music + gallery), new characters, outfits, & levels, and also local multiplayer! 

You can see everything in this shiny new trailer:

[previewyoutube=NG8wzQc6oH0;full][/previewyoutube]

We will also be releasing the official OST for the game alongside this update, for which a discounted bundle will be available too. We do not have a specific release date yet, but we can say it will be very soon. We are excited to share this update with everyone!

notes.title: Sep 2nd Update - Soul Balancing
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you've been enjoying the game. Based on player feedback, the development team has decided to re-balance the pricing of characters and skins in game so it does not feel like as much of a grind.

You can view some of the new pricing changes below. We hope these changes will make the game more enjoyable!
